name: philosophy_query
title: Philosophy terminology lookup
description: Query explicitly selected philosophical concepts using the exact captured terminology resource. Returned preferences are unadopted suggestions.

target.label: Target language
target.description: Choose the language of the reference preferences.

selections.label: Intended concepts
selections.description: Choose the intended logic senses. A matching spelling alone does not select a sense.

options.label: validity
options.description: Use this entry when discussing an argument's validity; do not infer the intended sense from the spelling alone.

options.label: soundness
options.description: Use this entry for the selected logic sense of soundness, not sound as audio or a condition of health.

options.label: premise
options.description: This project's preferred term applies to the selected argument context.

options.label: inference
options.description: Use the preferred term only within the explicitly selected reasoning context.

output.emptyDescription: No preference matches this text and the explicitly selected concepts.
